title: The 5 most overhyped tech trends of 2026

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "5" is just a number—it's the hype and false promises that matter, not the count. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But the real issue is that each of those 5 trends relies on flawed tech, like overpromised quantum computing or AI that can't deliver. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Quantum computing isn't the only one—blockchain hype also failed, but that doesn't mean the count is wrong. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: The problem is that the "5" is arbitrary and subjective. Who decides what's overhyped? It's a flawed framework. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The real debate is whether we should trust the hype at all. (4 sec)
